svg.aria-label: Eighteen weeks in three phases, durations estimated. Phase 0, about four weeks with the repository closed: settle package identity, import the tree with full history, set up the automated build, get the two-target Tier 1 per-pull-request gate running. Phase 1, about six weeks: merge the existing private forks through the normal pull request process as a rehearsal of that process, and create the first ISO. Phase 2, about eight weeks: upstream triage automation, nightly and weekly builds, first stabilisation branch, targeting the first dated release. Each phase ends on a condition someone other than the author can check.
